name: cdn-ech-outer-block
description: The shared ECH outer name cloudflare-ech.com is on the blocklist (reassembling box, RST both ways), and so is the zone's own name — a tripwire: a client that fell back to a plain hello would show it, and the censor's log would say so. Every ECH hello to Cloudflare dies. Op cdn: the CDN route is reported dead and is NOT retried with a plain hello (owner decision D-2: no plain fallback unless the signed flag says so); the direct families are untouched.
analogue: Russia's block of cloudflare-ech.com (November 2024): one rule ends ECH to every Cloudflare site at once. Plan §2.1 lists it as what the CDN add-on does not rescue. Model: exact outer name, full reassembly. Not modelled: blocking by the ECH extension's presence rather than by name, or ECH GREASE handling.
